facts.name: HSBC
sentences: HSBC's shares moved 5% or more on 5 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 8 April 2026, when the stock rose 6.0%.
The stock is up 13.6% this year, and at $89.37 it sits 17.1% below its 52-week closing high of $107.86 from 3 August 2026.
$1,000 invested in HSBC five years ago would be worth $3,055 today.
